objective: Exploratory exact census with frozen predictions. On every connected cubic graph with at most 8 vertices (K4, K33, the prism and the five on 8 vertices), with Z2-Tseitin (parity knots) and Z3-Tseitin (sum-mod-3 knots) under several charge placements with nonzero total, compute the least level at which the affine relaxation over F2, F3, F5, Q and Z refutes the network, the plain hole bound, and graph parameters (treewidth, toggle width, a balanced-separator size). Check that not-all-equal networks are possible. Predictions P1-P6 are frozen in the contract.
status: Closed: supported by DEEP-HOLES-20261020-001A-E001 (exploratory; frozen predictions P1-P6 all hold; controls pass; the independent check verified 108 refutations, 87 solutions and 30 integer refutations by substitution). On all 8 connected cubic graphs with at most 8 vertices, 30 charge networks (parity under three placements, sum mod 3 on K4, K33 and the prism under two): F2 (parity), F3 (sum mod 3) and Z refute at level 3; every other tested field (F3, F5, Q for parity; F2, F5, Q for sum mod 3) refutes exactly at the toggle width (5 or 6), whatever the placement. The plain hole bound is 2 on every network (each scope is a hole of rank |E|-1). Depth is not a function of treewidth (treewidth-3 graphs have depth 5 or 6). NAE networks are all possible.
title: Charge holes: an exact census of refuting levels
